content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Zilla Parishad Satara Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Satara Medical Officer Vacancy Details 2026
Zilla Parishad Satara Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Zilla Parishad Satara Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Zilla Parishad Satara recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Zilla Parishad Satara recruitment is Medical Officer. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Medical Officer post as per the official notification released by Zilla Parishad Satara.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post is MBBS. Candidates must possess this degree to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q5. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Medical Officer post is scheduled to be held on 21 September 2026. Candidates should report at the specified time.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. It is free to apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Medical Officer position is Contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed term.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification date was 08 September 2026, and the Walk-in Interview date is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer role involves an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates must clear both stages.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the Zilla Parishad Satara office. Candidates should reach the venue on the specified date and time.
